title: 2026-11-12 论文推荐
description: 10 篇推荐：Decode Token Parallelism (NVIDIA, 长上下文解码吞吐较 DCP 高 1.7 倍)、One-Sided Expert-Parallel All-to-All for Mixture-of-Experts  (NVIDIA, 免元数据单边写入 + 就地 GEMM，小批 MoE 解码比 DeepEP 快 1)、Placing LLM Lookup Tables by Per-Layer Prefetch Deadlines (Microsoft, 表下沉 NVMe 仅增 1.4% 时延，主机内存 212→34 GiB)、Bursts That Outlast Themselves (Microsoft, 命中率 10%、吞吐减半、积压涨 70 分钟)、ForeSpark (Meta, 吞吐超 DSpark 1.77 倍，SLO 下请求速率 1.51 倍)、REAL Loss (The University of Hong Kong, 真实 EAL 损失 + 路径权重无偏估计，只换损失函数即超过 WTV/VSD/D)、Train High, Ship Low (Uppsala University, 通信降至 1.6%，带宽受限下更新快 2.2 倍)

highlights.name: Decode Token Parallelism
highlights.note: 权重按层块分节点、注意力留本地，长上下文解码吞吐 1.7×

highlights.name: NVLinkOneSided
highlights.note: 免元数据单边 all-to-all，小批 MoE 解码比 DeepEP 快 1.2–3.0×

highlights.name: SlackTier
highlights.note: 按预取期限把 203 GB 查表下沉 NVMe，主机内存 212→34 GiB
